title: Frankfurter Buchmesse 2024
summary: Our first Frankfurt stand, with our children’s and adult lists.
body:
Our first stand at the heart of international publishing: five days of rights meetings introducing our children’s and adult lists, with Italy as Guest of Honour and more than 4,300 exhibitors.

[Read our report from the fair](/news/frankfurt-book-fair-2024/)
image_alt: Our team at our first stand at the Frankfurt Book Fair 2024
seo_description: Epsilon Publishing Group opened its first stand at the Frankfurt Book Fair, 16–20 October 2024, with its children’s and adult lists.
